text: 2. SANDRA We were going out for a while. I met him when we were studying in Rome on an Erasmus program. It was a great few months. We tried to keep the relationship going after he went back to Belgium, but it's difficult maintaining a long-distance relationship. We couldn't afford to visit each other very often, and in the end we split up. We've remained friends, which I suppose is important, but I sometimes wish we'd stayed together. Yeah, I wish we hadn't split up.
